producer_report.summary:
`setup --ci` now skips the sccache install. Step 4 prints a skip message when `--ci` is set. Without `--ci`, setup still installs the pinned sccache. I did not measure CI time, so the speedup is unconfirmed. `athena.toml`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and the `[tools.sccache]` pin are unchanged.

The skip decision is a small function, `skip_sccache(ci)`, in `xtask/src/main.rs`. A new unit test checks that `--ci` skips and non-CI setup does not.

I added a Changed entry to `CHANGELOG.md` and corrected the sccache line in `README.md`. In `docs/decisions.md` I added a new entry, D81, explaining why `--ci` skips sccache.

`cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked -p xtask` pass. The xtask run covers the new test and the boundary-scan policy tests. The full `cargo test --locked` output was too large to read, so I did not see its final result.

checks_run.note: Output was truncated; I did not read its final result. The xtask run passed.

open_issues: The 4 to 9 minute figures come from the request; I did not measure CI time.
mistakes: A first CHANGELOG edit failed on an ambiguous match, so I retried with more context. There was no lasting effect.
The workspace-wide cargo test output was too large to read, so I only confirmed the xtask run.
learnings: Decisions are numbered; D80 was the last, so I added D81.
Setup flags are read via flags.ci in xtask/src/main.rs.
